source.title: Fernando Alonso — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson (verify page byline)
source.locator: Claim-specific page sections recorded under each claim.evidence
source.verification_note: Formula 1 page text inspected on 2026-10-24 for these locators; independent publisher corroboration and human EN/UK review remain outstanding.

claims.en: Alonso won consecutive Formula 1 Drivers' World Championships with Renault in 2005 and 2006.
claims.uk: Алонсо здобув два поспіль титули чемпіона світу Формули-1 з Renault у 2005 та 2006 роках.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame heading '2005, 2006'; introductory paragraph on consecutive Renault titles.
FIA 2013 Malaysian GP preview, Alonso 200th Grand Prix fact: 2005 and 2006 Renault titles.

claims.en: Alonso made his Formula 1 debut with Minardi in 2001.
claims.uk: Алонсо дебютував у Формулі-1 з Minardi у 2001 році.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Onward and upward he sped': Minardi test, F3000 and F1 debut the following season (2001).
FIA 2013 Malaysian GP preview, Alonso 200th Grand Prix fact: 2001 Australian GP debut for Minardi.

claims.en: Alonso won his first Formula 1 Grand Prix in Hungary in 2003.
claims.uk: Алонсо здобув свою першу перемогу на Гран-прі Формули-1 в Угорщині у 2003 році.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Onward and upward he sped': Hungary pole and youngest Grand Prix winner in 2003.
FIA Hungarian GP race preview, Hungaroring history: Alonso first GP victory in 2003.

claims.en: Alonso joined Ferrari for the 2010 Formula 1 season.
claims.uk: Алонсо приєднався до Ferrari в сезоні Формули-1 2010 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'In pursuit of a new challenge': Ferrari hire for 2010 and five wins.

gaps: Record precise per-claim source locators and independent corroboration.
Human review of both languages and exact revision required before publication.
